thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT A-88499  elevated error rate and latency on embeddings endpoints (/v1/embeddings, /v1/embeddings/bulk) in us-east-1. p95 latency +3.7x, intermittent 502/504s. Auto-pager: eng-oncall.
Priya (eng-oncall): Ack. Spinning up bridge. First ask: is this noisy-tenant traffic, a model degradation, or a worker restart storm?
Miguel (sre): Looking at ingress. Bulk embedding endpoint (/v1/embeddings/bulk) shows sustained large payloads and many concurrent connections from a handful of API keys. Worker queue depth rising on emb-q8 pools. Chat and standard text generation look normal.
Carla (product-ops): Support already seeing N reports about embeddings timing out. If we throttle aggressively we should warn customers.
Priya (eng-oncall): Mitigation plan (fast lane): 1) Apply strict per-route global caps for embeddings endpoints, preserve chat. 2) Temporarily disable the /v1/embeddings/bulk route so it can't spin large multi-request batches. 3) Reduce non-enterprise per-tenant embeddings quota and enforce token-based rate limiting for bulk traffic. 4) Notify top customers.
Ava (infra): I can flip the feature flag for bulk endpoint and roll an edge rule. Do we want immediate takedown?
Miguel (sre): Yes - disable bulk endpoint for now, then set per-route caps. Commands:
Miguel (sre): ```
# disable bulk endpoint in routing layer
redwoodctl route update --route /v1/embeddings/bulk --enabled false --reason "emergency-disable-bulk-A-88499"

# set global caps to shed load while preserving chat
redwoodctl rate-limit set --route /v1/embeddings --global-rpm 1000 --reason "protect-chat-A-88499"
redwoodctl rate-limit set --route /v1/embeddings/bulk --global-rpm 0 --reason "disabled-bulk-A-88499"
```
Miguel (sre): Applying rules now... applied. :white_check_mark: Edge config propagated.
Noah (platform): Also adding a route-specific quota that differentiates by content-type header and request size so big multi-doc requests get stricter limits. I'll push a policy update.
Noah (platform): ```
redwoodctl quota add-policy --route /v1/embeddings --policy "size_based" --max_tokens 20000 --per_min 30 --reason "size-policy-A-88499"
```
Priya (eng-oncall): And per-tenant reduction for non-enterprise: lower to 50 req/min, enterprise tenants excluded.
Priya (eng-oncall): ```
redwoodctl quota update --route /v1/embeddings --tenant-type non-enterprise --limit 50/m --reason "emergency-cap-A-88499"
```
Evan (support): I'll syndicate a short status note to the status page and send targeted emails to the top 20 customers using embeddings. Template: "We've temporarily disabled bulk embedding uploads and applied conservative rate limits to protect latency-sensitive routes. We're monitoring and will provide updates every 30m."
Carla (product-ops): Good. Add a note about alternative: encourage customers to use streaming small-batch embeddings or schedule large jobs off-peak with our batch job API.
Ava (infra): Quick infra update: I toggled the feature flag bulk_embeddings_enabled=false on canary edge nodes and started a rolling disable. Deploy log: ```
[2026-03-15T04:02:12Z] flags: bulk_embeddings_enabled=false
[2026-03-15T04:02:18Z] health: canary ok
```
Miguel (sre): Metrics showing improvement: embedding error rate from 11.6% -> 2.3% in 6m, p95 latency reduced ~35%. However one VIP tenant still hitting high concurrency causing per-worker mem pressure.
Priya (eng-oncall): Who's the noisy tenant? Can we throttle their API key specifically?
Miguel (sre): Yes. Identified API key x-plt-9983; I've applied a targeted token quota: 20 req/min for that key on embeddings routes.
Miguel (sre): ```
redwoodctl quota update --api-key x-plt-9983 --route /v1/embeddings --limit 20/m --reason "noisy-tenant-throttle-A-88499"
```
Evan (support): That tenant's account owner contacted support; they reported a scheduled sync that misconfigured parallelism. They're pausing jobs. I'll coordinate follow-up.
incident-bot: Incident A-88499 severity set to SEV2  localized service disruption for embeddings/rerank; chat unaffected. Next auto-update in 20m.
Priya (eng-oncall): Handoff plan: I'll stay for one more update cycle, then hand to Miguel for bridge ownership and RCA. Action items for SRE: collect worker heap profiles, list of top API keys, time-series of batch sizes, and review whether batch-size limits should be added to model runtime.
Miguel (sre): On it. Also plan to add a temporary traffic-shaper that prefers single-request embeddings over bulk once we re-enable bulk.
Noah (platform): I'll prepare a follow-up config change to re-enable bulk behind a tokenized queue and lower default batch_size=4 for 24h.
Carla (product-ops): Support message sent to affected customers. Draft for public status: "Temporary rate limits and bulk endpoint disablement in us-east-1 affecting embeddings. Chat unaffected. We are monitoring and will update within 1 hour"
Evan (support): Two enterprise accounts reported 429s after token throttle; they're acknowledged and support is coordinating workaround. Logging those for customer comms.
Priya (eng-oncall): Handoff to Miguel in 25m. Please keep this thread as official incident log. Miguel, when stable, roll back route-level caps gradually and restore per-tenant quotas only after confirming steady worker queues.
Miguel (sre): Taking bridge ownership. Will push updates every 15m or on any change. :thumbsup:
